css: body{font-family:'Archivo Black','Space Grotesk','Noto Sans TC','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif}.badge{display:inline-block;border:6px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;box-shadow:10px 10px 0 var(--ink);padding:14px 30px;font-size:38px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase}h1{font-size:var(--title);line-height:.98;margin-top:48px;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-transform:uppercase}h1 em{font-style:normal;background:#fff;border:6px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:12px 12px 0 var(--ink);padding:0 18px;display:inline-block;line-height:1.1}p{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:50px;line-height:1.4;margin-top:44px;max-width:980px;font-weight:700}
